notes: TROOP 0.5.0 adds Roots & Rockets: a saved offline Earth-and-Moon career with 24 crops, 24 working citizens, 19 occupations, finite markets, delivery quests, oil refining, vehicle fuel, lunar solar panels and battery storage. Choose ROOTS & ROCKETS or MOON EXPEDITION from the menu. Photographic lunar skies, distant crater relief, and fixes for overlapping Earth terrain and debug-world ground are shared improvements. Public multiplayer retains the classic combat and lunar expedition modes; local society wallets and farms are not imported online. Updater bootstrap 3 and protocol 11 are retained. Apply the offered signed update or install the full 0.5.0 package; versions older than 0.4.10 need the full installer. The server and every player must show 0.5.0 before joining together.
